Game Overview

In Canon Bubble, the core idea is straightforward: aim, shoot, and pop in Canon Bubble. Strategically match colors to clear the board and rack up points. With its quick-paced action and simple controls, this captivating bubble-bursting challenge offers endless fun for all ages. Keep bubbles at bay to avoid a game-over and achieve high scores!
